title: Add your team
summary: Your staff check codes and mark who came. They never see customers' numbers or your money.

steps.title: Open Team
steps.body: On a phone, tap More, then Team. On a computer, go to Settings, then Team.

steps.title: Invite someone
steps.body: Under "Invite staff", type their email and tap "Send invite". Send them the invite link on WhatsApp too (tap Copy). They sign in with Google or an email and password, and go straight to Check a code.

steps.title: What they can do
steps.body: Staff see Check a code: today's bookings, booking refs and drop cards. They tap Arrived when customers come in and confirm Tikkas. They never see your customers' numbers, your customer list or your money.

steps.title: Remove someone
steps.body: When someone leaves, tap Remove next to their name, then "Remove" again to be sure. They can't sign in to your business any more.
